request.subject: SITE:VILLAGE

layers.text: Erase only the flat green and grey ground slab under the hamlet and the grass yard between the cottages, making them fully transparent, never white. Do not change anything else: the three thatched cottages and the short dark wooden fence stay exactly as they are, with the same colours, outline and art style.
